description: This file defines a Flutter widget for adding a new task in a task management app. It includes UI components for task title, note, date, time, and list selection, and handles user interactions such as date/time pickers and saving the task to the database with optional notifications.

classes.name: AddTaskScreen
classes.description: Stateful widget representing the screen for adding a new task.

classes.name: _AddTaskScreenState
classes.description: State class containing the logic and UI for the AddTaskScreen widget.

methods.name: refreshNotes
methods.description: Fetches all tasks, lists, and users from respective databases and updates the state.

methods.name: _selectDate
methods.description: Displays a date picker dialog for selecting the task reminder date.

methods.name: _selectTime
methods.description: Displays a time picker dialog for selecting the task reminder time.
